Entries.Original: Maaan, the enemies aren't coming at all... Can I close my eyes for a bit?
Didn't I say this before? Absolutely not. You're going to fall asleep the moment you do.
Fine. Megumin, could you do your psychic zappy thing on me? Like one of those handshake prank toys. That should shock me wide awake.
Don't ask fer somethin' dangerous like that! If I let out an electric shock, it's gonna be like a lightning strike, and yer gonna end up fried 'n' crispy!
If you have such a power, you should be using it in battle.
Oh, it looks like we have some company.
